description: This file defines classes and methods for managing polygon data layers on a map, including creation, editing, cutting, rotating, and saving polygon geometries within a mapping application. It includes classes for individual polygon items and the data layer handling multiple polygons.

classes.name: TbPolygonDataLayerItem
classes.description: Represents a single polygon item on the map, supporting creation, editing, labeling, and interaction such as cut and rotate modes.

classes.name: TbPolygonsDataLayer
classes.description: Manages a collection of polygon data layer items, including placement, extraction, and saving of polygon coordinates.

methods.name: isEditing
methods.description: Returns whether the polygon is currently being edited.

methods.name: updateBubblingMouseEvents
methods.description: Updates the bubbling mouse events option for the polygon.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the polygon item from the map and releases associated resources.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a polygon or rectangle layer based on data and applies styles.

methods.name: unbindLabel
methods.description: Unbinds tooltip labels from the polygon container.

methods.name: bindLabel
methods.description: Binds a tooltip label to the polygon container.

methods.name: doUpdate
methods.description: Updates the polygon's style, shape, and labels based on new data.

methods.name: doInvalidateCoordinates
methods.description: Invalidates and updates polygon coordinates.

methods.name: addItemClass
methods.description: Adds a CSS class to the polygon element.

methods.name: removeItemClass
methods.description: Removes a CSS class from the polygon element.

methods.name: enableDrag
methods.description: Enables dragging of the polygon for editing.

methods.name: disableDrag
methods.description: Disables dragging of the polygon.

methods.name: onSelected
methods.description: Handles actions when the polygon is selected, including mode toggling for cut and rotate.

methods.name: onDeselected
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the polygon is deselected.

methods.name: canDeselect
methods.description: Determines if the polygon can be deselected based on current modes.

methods.name: removeDataItemTitle
methods.description: Returns the title for the remove data item action.

methods.name: removeDataItem
methods.description: Removes the polygon data item by saving null coordinates.

methods.name: enablePolygonEditMode
methods.description: Enables editing mode for the polygon.

methods.name: disablePolygonEditMode
methods.description: Disables editing mode for the polygon.

methods.name: enablePolygonCutMode
methods.description: Enables cut mode for the polygon, allowing user to cut the shape.

methods.name: disablePolygonCutMode
methods.description: Disables cut mode.

methods.name: enablePolygonRotateMode
methods.description: Enables rotate mode for the polygon.

methods.name: disablePolygonRotateMode
methods.description: Disables rotate mode.

methods.name: savePolygonCoordinates
methods.description: Saves the current polygon coordinates to the data layer.

methods.name: updatePolygonShape
methods.description: Updates the shape of the polygon based on data.

methods.name: placeItem
methods.description: Places a polygon item on the map based on layer data.

methods.name: extractPolygonCoordinates
methods.description: Extracts polygon coordinates from data.

methods.name: savePolygonCoordinates
methods.description: Saves polygon coordinates to the data source.

methods.name: getDataKeys
methods.description: Returns the data keys used for polygon data.

methods.name: defaultBaseSettings
methods.description: Provides default settings for the polygon data layer.

methods.name: doSetup
methods.description: Performs setup operations for the data layer.

methods.name: isValidLayerData
methods.description: Validates if the layer data is suitable for polygons.

methods.name: createLayerItem
methods.description: Creates a new polygon layer item.
